load_state_dict_from_checkpoint: load a model state dict from a checkpoint path supporting safetensors, pth, and bin formats with lazy loading
load_state_dict_into_model: load an adapted state dict into a torch model with optional tensor parallel sharding across ranks
register_adapter_for_architecture: register a state dict adapter function to convert weights from a source format like hf to FMS format
list_sources_for_architecture: list all registered weight source formats available for a given model architecture like llama
create_lazy_safetensors_dict: create a LazySafetensorsDict that lazily loads tensors from safetensors files only when accessed by key
